record_scope: one master pheromone stock plus its eight frozen aliquots

required_fields.donor_colony_ids: array of exactly four distinct non-test colony IDs
required_fields.hindguts_per_donor_colony: array of four integers each exactly 8
required_fields.aliquot_ids: array of exactly eight unique IDs
required_fields.preparation_deviation: null or text; any deviation preserved

session_use_required_fields.batch_id: must exactly equal the parent master-stock batch_id containing this session-use record
session_use_required_fields.aliquot_id: one frozen aliquot ID from the same parent batch_id
session_use_required_fields.marked_arm_passes_completed: integer 0..6 or null only when the observed count is unavailable under application_status=failed
session_use_required_fields.control_arm_passes_completed: integer 0..6 or null only when the observed count is unavailable under application_status=failed
session_use_required_fields.marked_arm_actual_volume_ul: number in [0,12] or null only when unavailable under application_status=failed
session_use_required_fields.control_arm_actual_volume_ul: number in [0,12] or null only when unavailable under application_status=failed
session_use_required_fields.application_failure_description: null when application_status=complete; nonempty text when application_status=failed

validation_rules: donor colonies must be distinct from all 12 test colonies
32 hindguts / 8.000 mL DCM must equal 4 hindgut-equivalents/mL
4 eq/mL * 0.012 mL / 10 cm must equal 0.0048 eq/cm
each session-use batch_id must exactly equal the parent master-stock batch_id and its aliquot_id must belong to that same batch
an aliquot may be thawed exactly once
no recipe or application change is permitted after collection starts
exactly one master-stock batch record may exist for the dataset and all session-use records must reference that one batch_id

if application_status=complete then marked_arm_passes_completed=6, control_arm_passes_completed=6, marked_arm_actual_volume_ul=12, control_arm_actual_volume_ul=12, and application_failure_description=null

if application_status=failed then partial or unavailable observed pass counts and volumes must be preserved honestly, application_failure_description must be nonempty, and affected trials must use verified_apparatus_or_stimulus_preparation_failure_logged_without_consulting_behavioral_outcome; never fabricate six passes or 12 uL
dataset_cardinality_rule: Exactly one master-stock batch record is permitted for the entire 480-trial dataset; every chemical session-use record and every trial must reference that single batch_id.
